author: Tesla
description:
FSD V15 now starting to roll out – upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network 

Safety:
25x better handling of safety critical cases

Tesla Reality View:
New real-time generative driving visualization that continuously streams a view from an arbitrary virtual camera situated above your vehicle, enabling you to see and control what FSD is planning to do.

Select between fullscreen visualizations, maps or a split view - or choose quiet mode for a calming cabin experience.

Upcoming navigation turns display directly in the driving visualization.

Turn signals are quieter and fade out after a few clicks.

Navigation:
Navigation for start & end of the trip now learns end-to-end from fleet route preferences. Later v15 releases will expand this to the entire route.

Improved Detection:
You also should notice better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water, plus more natural speed handling in school zones and inclement weather.
